verdict.rationale: No first-party document in the pack describes replying in threads. Community hands-on reports do indicate that Teams channels have threading: users contrast channels with DMs, which lack threading, and describe following threads. Those same users criticize the threading UX, but nobody reports that replies fail to stay attached to the original message, so this is not a dispute. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of channel reply threads, explicit evidence that replies stay attached to the parent message, and threading in DMs/chats.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can reply in threads so side discussions stay attached to the original message

citations.quote: inconsistent UI between channels and direct chats (no threading/code blocks in DMs)
Took me long to realise I was looking at the chat window and to follow along the threads.
The biggest issue was the threading; it truly beggars belief
